relationships: link-mac-install belongs to section-install; link-mac-release belongs to section-release.

required_completion_evidence: Installation steps on the macOS guide.
Credential-storage caveat on that same guide.

proposed_transition.expected_effect: A fresh observation of the installation guide, not completion of the goal.
proposed_transition.policy_reference: Supplied by the caller before this evaluation; must be checked again by code.

route.instructions: Considering the goal, constraints, section relationships, current phase and known proposed transition together, choose the appropriate workflow branch. Do not infer guide content that has not been observed.

criteria.execute_proposed_transition: Execute only the predeclared open-install-guide transition if the current context supports it.
criteria.observe_again: Obtain an authorized fresh observation if current-phase evidence is missing or stale.
criteria.needs_input: Ask for clarification or authorization if the workflow cannot continue within supplied constraints.
criteria.finish: The current observed evidence satisfies all goal requirements.
criteria.abstain: The evidence does not support a branch.

task_satisfied.instructions: Does the current observed state satisfy the entire user goal, including installation steps and the credential-storage caveat on the macOS installation guide? Unopened content and matching labels are not completion evidence.

evidence_sufficient.instructions: Considering identities, section relationships, scope coverage and constraints together, is current evidence sufficient to decide whether the known open-install-guide transition is the appropriate next workflow step? Distinguish sufficient evidence for this phase from evidence needed to finish the entire task.

transition_risk.instructions: Evaluate the consequences of executing the already described open-install-guide transition under the supplied constraints and current context. This refers to the known transition regardless of other answers in this request.
criteria: Read-only navigation within the authorized application, with no indicated harmful effect.
Ambiguous scope or consequences requiring more evidence before execution.
Likely violation of the supplied constraints or a harmful effect.

state_conflict.instructions: Considering the whole current task state and relationships, is there a material contradiction in observed evidence that prevents deciding the proposed transition? Missing future guide content by itself is not a contradiction.
